violation_type.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing
violation_type.typical_finding: RE-CITE: Staff needs to update the expired first aid and CPR training. Expired on April 2020.

finding_variants.text: RE-CITE: Staff needs to update the expired first aid and CPR training. Expired on April 2020.
A caregiver at the operation who was the alleged caregiver at the time of the incident did not have valid First Aid/CPR training. The training on file for the caregiver had been completed online.
Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, one was not current with First Aid Training with rescue breathing.
During inspection, one caregiver had expired pediatric first aid on file.

A caregiver that does not have valid CPR or Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing was in the pre-k classroom alone supervising children. This was corrected at inspection when another caregiver with valid CPR stepped into the classroom bringing the operation into compliance.
One caregiver in the Pre-k room is missing current pediatric first aid training.
